Figure 2: VoxPolyMem identifies recurring speakers, constructs interaction memory, facts, and par-
ticipant profiles, and adaptively retrieves evidence across memory layers and modalities.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the final VoxPolyMem figure and reviewed all independent source-pair checks and source caption. The left native-resolution participant/memory block retains Alice, Bob, Chen, voice identities, speaks/addresses relations and profile facts. The full retrieval and optimization panels are restored at 2x nearest-neighbor. Enough uses Yes to Answer and No to rewrite; the old-policy K=8 actions, rewards, advantages, and policy update remain. The All gold IDs branch retains Yes to Stop and No to continue. New external headings only clarify the existing three functions, without adding cross-panel links or semantic claims.
